en-US.name: Complexity
en-US.summary: Watch your Plex library on Echo Show.
en-US.description: Complexity plays movies and TV from your own Plex Media Server on Echo Show devices. Link your Plex account with a short code at plex.tv/link; no password is ever shared with the skill. Not affiliated with Plex, Inc.
examplePhrases: Alexa, ask complexity which server am I using
Alexa, ask complexity to switch server

publishingInformation.testingInstructions: Requires a Plex account with a Plex Media Server that has Remote Access enabled.
